detail.quote:
The possible cases are:
1. First draw is red (1), second draw is blue (2).
2. First draw is blue (1), second draw is red (2).
detail.explanation: This omits the other two valid ordered outcomes: red (2) then blue (1), and blue (2) then red (1). Each omitted outcome has probability \(4/81\), so part (1) should be \(16/81\), not \(8/81\).
